experiment_arm: without cargo-elicit; single worker; direct proof tools
scope: Selected computation APIs of original adler2 2.0.1; not whole-crate verification

commands: PATH=/workspace/toolchain/cargo/bin:$PATH RUSTUP_HOME=/workspace/toolchain/rustup CARGO_HOME=/workspace/toolchain/cargo /workspace/toolchain/aeneas-src/charon/charon/target/release/charon cargo --preset=aeneas --sysroot=default --start-from adler2::Adler32::new --start-from adler2::Adler32::checksum --start-from adler2::Adler32::from_checksum --start-from adler2::Adler32::write_slice --start-from adler2::adler32_slice --dest verification/selected-model -- --manifest-path Cargo.toml --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
extraction.copy_note: The fresh selected-model output is copied verbatim to verification/generated for imports. The earlier full-crate extraction is archived under full-extraction and is not imported; its generated text has .lean.txt extension.

checker_commands: ./verification/extract.sh (optional regeneration using the original Cargo manifest)
checker_details: Scripts invoke lake env lean from the prepared Aeneas backend, with explicit workspace module paths and --root; each module is elaborated and kernel-checked. check.sh rebuilds the generated model and all proof modules in dependency order. Logs check-*.log are the final sequential rebuild.

apis.contract: Successful return with a=1 and b=0.
apis.preconditions: Only representability encoded in Aeneas scalar/slice types.

apis.contract: For every Adler32 with arbitrary u16 halves, successful u32 result with natural value 65536*b+a.
apis.preconditions: Only representability encoded in Aeneas scalar/slice types.

apis.contract: For every u32, successful state with a=sum%65536 and b=sum/65536.
apis.preconditions: Only representability encoded in Aeneas scalar/slice types.

apis.contract: For every representable state and Slice U8, successful update equals scalar (a,b) bytes.val. scalar normalizes both seed halves, including for empty input; there is no normalized-seed assumption or artificial total length bound.
apis.preconditions: Only representability encoded in Aeneas scalar/slice types.

apis.contract: For every Slice U8, successful checksum with value 65536*(scalar (1,0) bytes).2+(scalar (1,0) bytes).1.
apis.preconditions: Only representability encoded in Aeneas scalar/slice types.

reference.description: foldl of a=(a+byte)%65521; b=(b+a)%65521, starting with both seed halves modulo 65521.

compute_core.coverage: Original generated compute body, six loops (nested main loop plus remainder vector loop, two lane-sum loops, serial tail), all U32X4 helpers, checked machine arithmetic, casts, indexing, slice splitting/chunking and iterator calls.
compute_core.internal_bounds: 5552 groups per internal four-lane chunk and 22208 bytes per outer chunk; these are derived implementation bounds, not a bound on total input length.

secondary_laws.preconditions: Explicit concatenation length <= Usize.max. split_equivalence additionally takes a representable whole slice whose value is xs++ys. Both paths succeed and return equal states.
secondary_laws.description: split_updates_correct proves the scalar law; split_equivalence executes both whole and split paths and proves equality of returned Adler32 states.

secondary_laws.preconditions: resume_equivalence works for every representable state and continuation slice. The two-part scalar law explicitly requires representable concatenation.
secondary_laws.description: resume_equivalence executes both direct and saved/restored continuation paths and proves equality of returned states.

trusted_boundaries: Pinned rustc/Charon extraction of the unchanged original sources for x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.
Pinned Aeneas translation and its standard machine integer, Result/loop, array, slice, and iterator models.
Lean kernel, standard library/mathlib/Aeneas checked dependencies, and only the three listed logical axioms.
The active fresh selected-API model has no project axioms. The earlier unused full-crate model with an opaque I/O type is archived as text outside the checked module graph.
preserved_failed_attempts: verification/attempts/resume-conditional.lean.txt is an unclaimed abandoned conditional lemma; stronger unconditional resume_equivalence is checked in APIs.lean. Intermediate diagnostic logs may show earlier failed attempts; final check-*.log and theorem roots determine current claims.
